newsitem.title: USA: PaineWebber muni research chief in move to FGIC.
newsitem.headline: PaineWebber muni research chief in move to FGIC.

text.p: Michael Johnston, head of municipal research at PaineWebber Inc, will move next week to a senior credit position at Financial Guaranty Insurance Co, a unit of GE Capital Services.
Market sources said Tuesday that Johnston, who joined PaineWebber in January, would begin at FGIC on Monday.
Johnston could not immediately be reached for comment. An FGIC spokeswoman said she could not confirm or deny the hire. GE Capital is a subsidiary of General Electric Co.

Prior to his position at PaineWebber, Johnston was an associate director at Sandler O'Neill & Partners LP. He also worked in municipal research for Kidder Peabody & Co and Moody's Investors Service Inc.
